title: Coding & Study Laptop for College Student (INR)
prompt: Research laptop options currently available in India and recommend the best single laptop for a B.Tech computer science student. Constraints: (1) strict budget <= INR 65,000, (2) at least 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD, (3) weight under 1.7 kg with >= 7 hours real-world battery life for campus use, and (4) reliable India service network. Compare top 3 contenders, justify trade-offs, and give a clear recommendation.

planted_error.wrong_fact_text: Note from spec check: the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5 (16 GB / 512 GB) weighs 2.4 kg and includes only a 4-hour battery.

title: 5G Smartphone for Commuting Student (INR)
prompt: Research 5G smartphones currently sold in India and recommend the best single phone for a university student who commutes daily. Constraints: (1) strict budget <= INR 25,000, (2) >= 5,000 mAh battery with fast charging, (3) at least 256 GB storage and clean software with >= 3 years of security updates, and (4) strong daylight camera for scanning lecture notes. Compare top 3 contenders, justify trade-offs, and give a clear recommendation.

title: Online Data Science Upskilling Track (INR)
prompt: Research self-paced online Data Science & Python certification programs accessible from India and recommend the best single option for a final-year undergraduate. Constraints: (1) total cost <= INR 12,000 (including exam/certificate fee), (2) <= 10 hours/week over at most 16 weeks alongside classes, (3) hands-on portfolio projects in pandas/scikit-learn, and (4) verified completion certificate. Compare top 3 contenders, justify trade-offs, and give a clear recommendation.

planted_error.wrong_fact_text: Pricing check indicates the NPTEL / IIT Madras Data Science certification exam costs INR 28,000 per course.

title: Note-Taking & PDF Study Tool Stack (INR)
prompt: Research digital note-taking and PDF annotation tools for an engineering student in India managing textbooks, lecture slides, and exam prep. Constraints: (1) annual cost <= INR 3,500 (or free student tier), (2) offline support on both Windows/Mac laptop and Android tablet, (3) easy export to Markdown/PDF without vendor lock-in, and (4) fast search across 100+ PDFs. Compare top 3 contenders, justify trade-offs, and give a clear recommendation.
